def: By regular steps or gradations; of or pertaining to gradation.
Having no peer or equal; matchless; superlative. "Her peerlessfeature." Shak.Unvailed her peerless light. Milton.--Peer"less*ly, adv.-- Peer"less*ness, n.
Pertaining to, or derived from, oxalic acid and aniline; --used to designate an acid obtained in white crystalline scales byheating these substances together.
To marry; to unite in marriage; to wed. [R.] "Man thuswedlocked." Milton.
The state or quality of being conjunctive. Johnson.
A little world; a miniature universe. Hence (so called byParacelsus), a man, as a supposed epitome of the exterior universe orgreat world. Opposed to macrocosm. Shak.
Having the stamens and pistils in separate flowers. Gray.
